name: nextcloud-aio-mastercontainer
description: The official Nextcloud installation method. Nextcloud AIO provides easy deployment and maintenance with most features included in this one Nextcloud instance. Included are... Nextcloud High performance backend for Nextcloud Files Nextcloud Office (optional) High performance backend for Nextcloud Talk and TURN-server (optional) Nextcloud Talk Recording-server (optional) Backup solution (optional, based on BorgBackup) Imaginary (optional, for previews of heic, heif, illustrator, pdf, svg, tiff and webp) ClamAV (optional, Antivirus backend for Nextcloud) Fulltextsearch (optional) Whiteboard (optional) Docker Socket Proxy (optional, needed for Nextcloud App API)

paths.name: Nextcloud AOI appdata docker volume
paths.description: Appdata (but this is a docker volume and is not in your appdata share)

ports.name: AIO webui
ports.description: Webui port for the AIO master container

variables.name: Nextcloud apache port
variables.description: Port for nextcloud. This should be reverse proxied to your server IP

variables.name: Nextcloud Data Directory
variables.description: Location of where you will store the nextcloud user data eg /mnt/user/nextcloud/ (the location you choose must exist)
